status_semantics.PARTIAL: Some inspected evidence, not sufficient to pass
status_semantics.BLOCKED: Prerequisite (access, matrix, endpoint or power) missing
status_semantics.PASS: Direct primary-source evidence and independent verification support gate
status_semantics.FAIL: Well-posed, sufficiently powered validation test failed (not a low power null)

research_routes.A: replicated matched RNA/protein interaction plus cellular origin
research_routes.H: association but no incremental clinical value
